project.name: Alpine Dawn — AI Voice Hero Background
project.description: Ultra-premium photorealistic hero background for a modern AI voice application: an alpine valley at sunrise with a mirror-calm lake, drifting morning mist and volumetric sunlight, fronted by a razor-sharp matte-black studio condenser microphone and a glowing cyan voice waveform. Graded and moved like a high-end commercial film — indistinguishable from live-action footage.
project.realism_target: indistinguishable from real footage; commercial-shot tier, never an illustration or 3D demo

loop.strategy: Every animated parameter is periodic with a period dividing exactly into 10 s (temporal frequencies are integer multiples of 0.1 Hz); particles travel closed orbital paths; film grain and all post effects cycle with the loop, so frame 600 is bit-identical to frame 0.

scene.title: Alpine lake at sunrise
scene.location: High-altitude alpine valley with a crystal-clear glacial lake

art_direction.note: Style inspiration only — no logos, branding or recognizable trade dress appears anywhere in frame.
art_direction.principle: Nothing in the scene may distract from interface content overlaid on top of it.

composition.rule: Symmetric center composition; the microphone sits on the vertical centerline, the sun sits right of center (x ≈ 0.62) to break symmetry gently.
composition.negative_space: Upper sky and lower lake surface stay visually quiet so app content overlays legibly.

atmospheric_perspective.model: physically based aerial perspective — each mountain layer loses contrast and saturation and lifts toward the sky color with distance

mist.behavior: thin morning mist floating naturally — very slow horizontal drift with gentle density breathing
mist.interaction: sunlight scatters through the mist volumes, producing soft volumetric shafts

airborne_dust.visibility: only where light shafts catch the particles
airborne_dust.motion: closed Lissajous micro-orbits at integer loop frequencies, drift speed under 2 cm/s

clouds.motion: extremely slow sinusoidal drift (±0.4% frame width at 0.1 Hz) so the loop point stays invisible

sun.state: just clearing the far ridge, diffused by atmosphere

water.reflections: crystal-clear mirror of mountains, sky, sun and trees, broken only by capillary ripples and sparse specular glints

mountain_layers.detail: jagged snow-capped granite ridgeline, golden rim light on sun-facing slopes
softer overlapping ridges with patchy snow

lake.shoreline: quiet gravel edges hidden below frame

pine_forest.species: alpine spruce silhouettes against the dawn
pine_forest.detail: extremely detailed — individual needle clusters and branch tiers resolve at 4K
pine_forest.motion: almost imperceptible wind sway, max ±0.5° at the tip, per-tree phase offsets

mist_volumes.placement: valley floor between mid_range and near_hills, hugging the water

dust_particles.region: air inside the god rays and around the microphone

microphone.finish: matte black with fine brushed-metal texture

parts.name: capsule_head
parts.detail: pill-shaped head with real woven mesh grille

parts.name: body
parts.detail: cylindrical brushed-metal body, vertical brushing direction

parts.name: bezel_ring
parts.detail: machined ring joining head and body

parts.name: stand
parts.detail: slim rod on a low-profile round base

microphone.focus: razor sharp — the focus plane is locked to the capsule while the background falls softly out of focus
microphone.animation: static — only camera motion, depth of field and light interact with it

voice_waveform.placement: emerging in front of the microphone, centered on the vertical axis

geometry.edge_window: Hann window so both ends taper to zero

behavior.description: Organic speech rhythm — smooth phrase-like swells separated by near-silent rests, no exaggerated movements.

amplitude_envelope.model: product of low-frequency sinusoids shaped by a smoothstep gate

mic_body_metal.normal_detail: fine brushed micro-scratches, subtle machining marks
mic_body_metal.reflections: subtle ray-traced environment reflections — matte, never glossy

mic_grille_mesh.geometry: two crossed layers of actual woven steel wire

mic_stand_metal.detail: matte powder-coat with faint edge wear on the base rim

forested_hillside.detail: dense conifer canopy resolved as soft texture at distance

pine_foliage.backlight_response: warm glow through needle edges facing the sun

volumetric_mist.density: thin, with soft procedural falloff at volume edges

dust_mote.visibility: bright only against light shafts, invisible in shadow

waveform_emissive.gradient: cyan core blending to blue at the extremities
waveform_emissive.emission_intensity: bright enough to bloom softly, never clipping to white

light_spill.character: slight soft cyan bounce, intensity kept low

key_light.quality: soft — naturally diffused by atmosphere and mist
produces: warm rim light on the microphone's right edge

fill_light.produces: cool blue mountain shadows and soft ambient fill

volumetric_god_rays.source: sunlight passing through ridge gaps and mist volumes

practical_light.effect: slight cyan spill onto the microphone body and water, modulated by the speech envelope

rim_light.motivation: physically motivated by the sunrise behind camera-right
rim_light.coverage: thin warm edge along the capsule and body's sun-facing side

exposure.strategy: protect sun-core highlights with filmic rolloff while holding shadow detail in the mountain shadows

lighting.global_illumination: full multi-bounce — sky bounce into shadows, warm ground bounce near the sunlit ridge
lighting.palette_strategy: cool blues and steel tones overall, with restrained golden sunrise accents on peaks, mist, water and the microphone's rim

lens.depth_of_field: shallow — background mountains melt into soft bokeh while the microphone stays razor sharp

focus_breathing.model: field of view oscillates ±0.15% sinusoidally at 0.1 Hz
focus_breathing.character: subtle, like a focus pull settling

lens.bokeh: smooth cinematic discs, slight cat-eye toward frame edges

movement.profile: cosine round trip (1.000 → 1.010 → 1.000) so the loop point stays invisible
movement.feel: professional cinema dolly — no sudden movements

stabilization_drift.model: per-axis sum of two sinusoids (0.2 Hz and 0.3 Hz) with phase offsets, amplitude ≤ 0.04% of frame width
stabilization_drift.character: microscopic handheld drift that keeps the frame feeling operated, not synthetic

animations.character: tiny water ripples and sparse twinkling glints, brighter and warmer inside the sun's light column

animations.model: closed Lissajous orbits — per particle: A_x sin(2π k_x t/10 + φ), A_y sin(2π k_y t/10 + ψ) with integer k
env(t) = 0.12 + 0.88 * smoothstep(0.14, 0.62, mix of sin(2π·k·t/10) terms, k ∈ {2,3,5})
animations.character: breathing waveform with a natural speech rhythm — swell, sustain, rest
imperceptible warmth breathing, shared by the god rays

engine_hints: unbiased path tracing with full global illumination
ray-traced reflections and refractions on water and metal
volumetric integration for mist, god rays and atmospheric haze
AI or temporal denoiser tuned to preserve grain-free micro-detail before grain is re-applied in post
rendering.detail_level: ultra-high — needle clusters, brushed-metal micro-scratches and woven grille wire all resolve at 4K
rendering.anti_aliasing: supersampling or high-sample TAA, no visible edge crawl

color_pipeline.output: Rec.709 / sRGB display-referred SDR master, HDR-ready grade

rendering.performance_notes: Designed as an app background: low temporal complexity, no flashing, large quiet regions compress efficiently and loop losslessly.

bloom.character: soft, wide-radius bloom on the sun core and waveform — elegant glow, never hazy

anamorphic_highlights.character: soft anamorphic-style horizontal streaks on the sun core and brightest water glints
anamorphic_highlights.note: styling only — the taking lens remains spherical

lens_effects.veiling_glare: restrained warm glare near the sun
lens_effects.bokeh_treatment: cinematic — smooth discs, no busy highlights

tone_mapping.curve: soft filmic contrast with gentle highlight rolloff
tone_mapping.black_point: lifted a touch for a premium filmic floor

color_grade.look: cool teal-blue shadows, neutral mids, golden highlights
color_grade.consistency: grade is static across the loop — only light animates

film_grain.loop_safe: grain pattern cycles with the 10 s loop

post_processing.sharpening: subtle, applied only inside the focus plane
post_processing.overlays: none — no text, no watermarks, no UI

constraints.motion_budget: everything moves almost invisibly; nothing distracts from the interface overlaid on top
constraints.flash_safety: no strobing or rapid luminance changes
constraints.overlay_readiness: quiet upper and lower thirds; the microphone is the only strong focal point
